title: Installation of the Green System Engine Driven Pump
abstract: Installation of the green system engine driven pump on the accessory gearbox drive pad, covering the pad seal, the drive spline preparation, the case drain connection and the ground pressurisation check that closes the task.

sections.purpose: This task installs the green system engine driven pump on the accessory gearbox drive pad, connects the case drain to the drive pad return line, and verifies the installation by a ground pressurisation and leak check.
sections.job_setup_note: The pump must be at ambient temperature before the pad seal is fitted, and the seal face must be clean and free of the previous compound. The spline must be greased with the approved compound only; a general purpose grease will carbonise on the drive pad. Torque the mounting nuts to 22 Nm. Have the ground hydraulic rig connected before the pump is offered up, because the system must be bled immediately after installation.
sections.procedure: 1. Remove the blanking plate from the drive pad and inspect the pad seal face. 2. Grease the drive spline with the approved compound and fit a new pad seal. 3. Offer the pump squarely to the drive pad and engage the spline without force. WARNING: DO NOT FORCE THE PUMP ONTO THE SPLINE. IF IT DOES NOT ENGAGE, WITHDRAW IT AND CHECK THE SPLINE ALIGNMENT. 4. Fit and torque the mounting nuts AES818405K5 in a diagonal sequence to the value given in the job set-up. 5. Connect the suction and delivery lines and torque the unions. 6. Route the case drain line to the drive pad return and secure the clamp at FIN 280GG8. CAUTION: DO NOT STRAIN THE CASE DRAIN LINE. A STRAINED LINE LOOSENS THE CLAMP JOINT IN SERVICE. 7. Reconnect the solenoid at FIN 16GG. 8. Refill and bleed the green system and check every joint for leakage at operating pressure. 9. Run the engine to idle and confirm the green system pressure.
sections.close_out: Confirm no leakage after the engine run and re-check the fluid level. Close the fan cowl and confirm the latching. Record the pump serial number and the fitment in the component history, and enter the installation in the technical log.

safety_precautions: Do not force the pump onto the drive spline.
Wear gloves and eye protection when you handle phosphate ester fluid.
Confirm the case drain routing before you pressurise the system.
Keep clear of the engine intake during the ground run.

tooling.description: Torque wrench 5-50 Nm with crowfoot set

title: Installation of the Green System Engine Driven Pump

issue.reason: The task is split into two standard specific variants, with a stop instruction where a spares pump does not match the variant on the job card.

abstract: Installation of the green system engine driven pump, published as two standard specific variants so that the case drain routing, the retainer torque and the flow sensor connection can never be taken from the wrong pump standard.

sections.purpose: This task installs the green system engine driven pump on the accessory gearbox drive pad, connects the case drain to the routing that matches the pump standard, and verifies the installation by a ground pressurisation and flow check. It is published as two variants: variant 1 for the original and interim kit case, variant 2 for the redesigned case with the scavenge gallery. The variant is selected from the pump data plate before any work starts.
sections.job_setup_note: Identify the pump standard before you route the case drain. The redesigned case has a scavenge gallery with its own port and a flow sensor connector; the original case has neither. Fitting a redesigned pump with the original case drain routing will send scavenge flow to the drive pad, which is exactly the condition the redesign removes. The spline must be greased with the approved compound only. Torque the mounting nuts to 19 Nm, or to 24 Nm where the interim shaft seal kit assembly GRDE393470-41 of MOD-151295 is fitted and its own retainer is used.
sections.procedure: 1. Identify the pump standard from the data plate before anything else and select the matching variant. Variant 1 covers the original and the interim kit case; variant 2 covers the redesigned case with the scavenge gallery. CAUTION: THE TWO VARIANTS ARE NOT INTERCHANGEABLE. A REDESIGNED PUMP FITTED WITH THE ORIGINAL CASE DRAIN ROUTING WILL LEAK INTO THE DRIVE PAD. 2. Where a pump drawn from spares does not match the variant on the job card, stop and return the unit. Do not open the spares release and do not continue on the other variant. 3. Remove the blanking plate from the drive pad and inspect the pad seal face. 4. Grease the drive spline with the approved compound and fit a new pad seal. 5. Offer the pump squarely to the drive pad and engage the spline without force. WARNING: DO NOT FORCE THE PUMP ONTO THE SPLINE. IF IT DOES NOT ENGAGE, WITHDRAW IT AND CHECK THE SPLINE ALIGNMENT. 6. Fit and torque the mounting nuts AES818405K5 in a diagonal sequence to the value given in the job set-up for the standard fitted. 7. Connect the suction and delivery lines and torque the unions. 8. Route the case drain to match the variant and secure the clamp at FIN 280GG8. 9. Variant 2 only: connect the flow sensor GRDE393470-41 harness and the transmitter D2910110594226 at the gallery boss. Variant 1 has no gallery boss and no sensor is fitted. 10. Reconnect the solenoid at FIN 16GG. 11. Refill and bleed the green system and check every joint for leakage at operating pressure. 12. Run the engine to idle and confirm the system pressure and, on variant 2, the case drain flow indication.
sections.close_out: Confirm no leakage after the engine run and re-check the fluid level. Close the fan cowl and confirm the latching. Record the pump serial number, the variant used, the case standard, the case drain routing and the flow indication reading against the aircraft, and enter the fitment in the component history.

type_data.effectivity_note: All classic model aircraft; variant 1 for the original and interim kit case, variant 2 post MOD-156032

safety_precautions: Do not force the pump onto the drive spline.
Wear gloves and eye protection when you handle phosphate ester fluid.
Confirm the case drain routing before you pressurise the system.
Keep clear of the engine intake during the ground run.
